Activity graphs terminate, bounded repairs reenter exactly, checkpoints resume, and instructional and downstream families remain isolated.

All required KC delivery remains present and accelerated bypass remains disabled.

A nonauthor independently verifies factual accuracy, scope, expert task models, objective-activity alignment, assistance fading, feedback, and repair design.

A solver distinct from the author and final approver completes every path from a separately distributed sanitized bundle without access to the author branch, keys, rationales, diagnostic mappings, or protected server files.
The overlay binds the solver, sanitized bundle hash, and passing protected-field scan/report hash to the exact source-plan hash.
Correct, incorrect, omission, help, retry, reveal, interruption, resume, invalid-item, mixed-route, and repair-limit paths are exercised.
The reviewer receives an accessibility-only sanitized bundle with the same key, rationale, diagnostic-mapping, protected-server-file, and author-branch exclusions as blind solve.
Keyboard, focus, semantics, contrast, zoom/reflow, reduced-motion, nonvisual representation, and accommodation behavior pass.
Accessible alternatives preserve the intended construct and activity-graph behavior.
The draft is compared with its wave and prior integrated wave for copied language, repeated scenarios, answer-pattern leakage, and template overfitting.
Any intentional reuse is bounded, justified, and does not collapse distinct KC identities or item families.

One explicit independent fact-check assignment exists for every required job specialty and signs off against the declared source ceiling, scope, assumptions, equations, representations, and boundary conditions.

orchestration_policy.assignment_materialization: Never modify this generated plan. Generate a separate wave overlay, materialize all person/run identities and evidence there, and validate it against the SHA-256 of the exact checked plan bytes.
orchestration_policy.clean_room: New-authoring agents receive only shared allowlisted architecture/contract inputs and their own job record. Pilot agents additionally receive only their matching approved prototype after rights clearance.
orchestration_policy.first_delivery_policy: Use normalized relation IDs and their explicit fields. First-delivery ordinal is a deterministic ready-job tie-break, not a prerequisite inferred from array proximity.
orchestration_policy.hard_dependency_policy: A prior authoring wave is required only for a cross-lesson HARD_PREREQUISITE whose target is a nested KC point of use. Hard capstone requirements remain recorded but do not manufacture shell-first-delivery order.
orchestration_policy.pilot_policy: The five exact approved prototypes form one structure-and-port pilot. They remain internal drafts and confer no production publication status.

production_author_batch_range.rationale: Eight to twelve authors preserve independent audit, blind-solve, accessibility, similarity, and integration capacity while retaining enough cross-domain variety to detect template overfitting; one hundred simultaneous authors would outrun those review bottlenecks.

publication_policy.statement: Generated content is an internal draft until rights, scientific review, reviewed hashes, and efficacy gates pass.

severity_taxonomy.definition: Critical integrity or safety failure: plan-pin/canonical-scope corruption, protected-content or key exposure, unauthorized rights use, held-scope activation, bypass activation, or a defect requiring immediate containment.
severity_taxonomy.required_disposition: Stop the wave, contain exposure, invalidate affected artifacts/hashes, and resolve before revalidation.

severity_taxonomy.definition: Major correctness or process failure: material factual/key error, missing required independent role, invalid KC/activity alignment, broken deterministic path, inaccessible essential path, or failed G01-G10 evidence.
severity_taxonomy.required_disposition: Resolve and rerun every affected review stage before integration.

severity_taxonomy.definition: Moderate bounded defect that does not invalidate a G01-G10 requirement or expose learners, but requires correction before publication.
severity_taxonomy.required_disposition: Internal-draft integration requires documented containment, owner, due date, and publication block; resolve before G12.

severity_taxonomy.definition: Minor editorial or maintainability defect with no material correctness, rights, accessibility, evidence, or execution effect.
severity_taxonomy.required_disposition: Track with an owner; fix opportunistically or before the next ordinary revision.

source_ledger_contract.statement: Separately recorded current authoritative/open factual sources may be used when URL, access date, license or terms, model-processing rights, source ceiling, and exact retrieval hash are reviewed; copied expressive prose remains forbidden.

unresolved_constraints.effect: The five internal prototype artifact locations, immutable hashes, processing-rights records, and prior review evidence were not supplied; pilot jobs cannot launch until supplied and verified.
The architecture is complete only to the supplied 2020 AAMC ceiling; present-day authority refresh remains pending.

Actual controller, integrator, author, rights reviewer, domain fact-checker, auditor, blind-solver, and approver person/run IDs are intentionally absent from this immutable plan and must be materialized in a separately validated wave overlay.
Learner validation, calibrated evidence recipes, exact efficacy thresholds, and broad-publication evidence do not yet exist; no wave checkpoint can waive them.
